items.summary: Witkoff met Putin at the Constantine Palace Wednesday morning, one day after the Oslo summit with Zelensky; Kushner joined virtually. Opening goodwill gesture: Russia released 74-year-old retired US schoolteacher Stephen Hubbard (held 4+ years). Witkoff said there was a 'basis for a ceasefire' and implored Putin to consider resuming trilateral Russia-US-Ukraine talks on technical issues; Putin thanked Trump for his efforts and expressed interest in restoring US-Russia economic cooperation (TASS/Interfax).
items.title: Witkoff-Putin St. Petersburg talks underway; Russia frees US prisoner, Witkoff cites 'basis for a ceasefire'
